text.en:
Kills with <primary/> Primary and <heavy/> Power Weapons grant #e${10 * #d}% Melee Ability Energy.
Most <special/> Special Weapons grant #e${20 * #d}%.

Glaives, Grenade Launchers, and Trace Rifles share the ability gains of primary weapons.

Dealing Melee Damage grants +35 Handling for 3 seconds.

enhanced (
var d = 1.1
#e Melee Ability Energy gains are increased by 10%.
)

<formula Ready Speed: [ready_0] />
<formula Stow Speed: [stow_0] />
text.zh-chs:
<primary/> 主武器和 <heavy/> 重武器击杀可获取 #e${10 * #d}% 近战技能能量。
大多数 <special/> 特殊武器获取 #e${20 * #d}% 能量。

偃月、追踪步枪、榴弹发射器相较其他特殊武器，仅获得一半能量。

使用近战技能造成伤害获得 +35 操控性，持续 3 秒。将 <title 重新装填 [G_refill] /> 弹匣。

#e 能量获取量提升 10%。
)
